Definition: properly, to hollow or arch, i.e. (figuratively) close; to shut
BiblicalUsage: gûwph means to shut, to close. In Nehemiah 7:3, the text says "let them shut the doors."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, gûwph, does its job quietly — to shut, to close — and I leave it at that.
